name: Triangulation

relations: A or B routes regulation through C

activation: direct A-B regulation is insufficient or avoided
a third actor becomes a carrier of tension, alliance, message, or legitimacy
maintenance: temporary relief reduces pressure for direct A-B repair
signatures: messages or pressure repeatedly travel through a third actor
C becomes structurally necessary to stabilize A-B
falsePositives: legitimate mediation with explicit mandate and exit

breakpoints.operation: restore direct A-B communication where safe and appropriate
make the third-party regulatory role explicit
change the rule that requires C to stabilize A-B
